items.q: where I first met Duke, and of course, Slim and I was on the bill with Duke Ellington and his band.

ctx.x: And here's what I want to say. Let's say two, three years later after I had met him, Slim and I played the Apollo, the same theater that I went to see him,

where I first met Duke, and of course, Slim and I was on the bill with Duke Ellington and his band. We did our thing, of course, and Duke had his band there and of course, he had the top billing. He was the thing. And Slim was -- this was Slim and my first exposure in a theater after we got together.
Oh, this was your first theater gig.
